tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground behind cards and bento tiles.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, inputs, buttons, menus, dialogs: every part sits on this, outlined by `line`.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Wells and selected states: segmented-control trough, slider rail, switch track off, current nav item, summary panels.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, menu items, ghost buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: THE stroke: 1px around cards, inputs, buttons, menus; row dividers. Deliberately faint (1.3:1) — see Accessibility.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Hover stroke on controls, heading underline rule, summary total rule.

tokens.name: line-bold
tokens.usage: Only where a stroke IS the control: radio and checkbox rings. 3.0:1+ on background and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, body, values, active icons. 12:1+ on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, placeholders, hints, inactive icons. 5.3:1+ light, 6.0:1+ dark.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Disabled text and decorative marks only (≈2:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The single filled emphasis: primary pill, checked boxes, switch on, slider fill, current page. Near-black in light, near-white in dark.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent. 12.6:1 light, 15.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Neutral badge and avatar fill; text on it is ink.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive deltas, success icons, status dots.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, negative deltas, destructive actions; the error stroke on fields.

styles.name: display-light
styles.usage: Second line of a stacked heading.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Figures in stat tiles and balances. Light, tabular.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Icon to label, menu item padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; bento gap (no shadows to clear, so tighter than Pebble).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero cards, dialogs, the login card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, badges, segmented control, rails.

stroke.note: Pebble Line has no shadows. Edges are 1px strokes; weight changes, not depth, mark emphasis.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Heading underline, summary total, selected tab, error field.
